description: Place a LIVE manual order exactly like the app's ticket: market or limit, post-only, resting (Polymarket time_in_force GTC), reduce-only, leverage up to the venue maximum. This moves real money. Opening orders stay within this key's max_order_usd and max_daily_usd and the account's portfolio mandate. funding (from Home) also needs the transfer scope. Reuse the same idempotency_key to retry safely; read the outcome with get_manual_order_receipt.

expected_position_id.description: With reduce_only, the position this order reduces.

funding.description: Fund this order from Home: {max_source_units, max_fee_units, expires_at}. Needs the transfer scope.

idempotency_key.description: Retry-safety key; reuse it for retries of the same order. Auto-generated when omitted.

leverage.description: Leverage for perps, 1 up to the venue maximum for the market.

outcome.description: Polymarket outcome name (e.g. Yes, No, a team, Draw).

post_only.description: Limit orders only: rest on the book, never take (Hyperliquid, Lighter; Polymarket with time_in_force GTC).

side.description: buy or sell (perps: buy = long, sell = short).

time_in_force.description: Polymarket only: FAK (default, fill what is there now) or GTC (rest on the book; limit only).

name: place_manual_order
